login.title: Sign in

errors.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.totp_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

login.joined: Your profile is ready. Sign in with your new password and an app code.

noAccess.title: No company access
noAccess.body: Your profile has not been added to any company. Ask the owner to add you.

home.title: Home
home.empty: No orders yet. Connect a store under Stores.

pages.placeholder: This screen is built in phase {phase}.

members.title: Companies and users
members.name: Name

errors.already_member: This user is already in the company.
errors.last_owner: A company needs at least one owner.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.company_exists: A company with this name already exists.
errors.role_sees_all: Owners and admins always see every company.
errors.pick_company: Pick at least one company, or “All companies”.

members.inviteTitle: Invitation link for {email} — shown only once
members.inviteBody: Send the link to the person. It is valid for 72 hours and works once. If they already have a profile they log in and accept; if they are new they choose a password and add 2FA themselves.
members.scopeHint: Owners and admins always see every company.
members.inviteScopeHint: Applies to Operator, Warehouse and Viewer only. No ticks = all companies; owners and admins always see all.

credentials.title: Access keys
credentials.intro: Keys are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM). After saving they are never shown again — only the last 4 characters.
credentials.label: Name
credentials.secretHint: Write-only. The field is empty when editing — enter a new key to replace it.

jobs.title: System jobs
jobs.intro: Background worker queues. Jobs that used up their retries go to the dead-letter queue and wait for a person.
jobs.empty: No jobs in the dead-letter queue.

invite.title: Invitation to {account}
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired or already used. Ask for a new one.
invite.newIntro: Create your profile for {email}. Only you know the password and the 2FA key.
invite.step2fa: 1. Add the key to your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password…)
invite.step2: 2. Choose a name and a password
invite.name: Name
invite.wrongUser: You are signed in with another profile. Sign out and sign in as {email}.

errors.invalid_code: Wrong code. Check the phone's clock and try a new code.
errors.invalid: Check the fields (the password needs at least 12 characters).
errors.invalid_invitation: This invitation cannot be used like that. If you already have a profile with this email, use “Sign in” above.
errors.use_login: If you already have a profile with this email, use “Sign in” above to accept the invitation.
errors.form_expired: The form was open too long. Reload the page and add the new key.

warehouses.empty: No warehouses connected yet. FHB and euShipments connections arrive in phases 2–3.
warehouses.emergencyBody: Sets every warehouse connection of this company to Read only and pauses the outbound queue. Nothing queued is lost.
warehouses.paused: The outbound queue is paused. Nothing is sent.
warehouses.stopPrompt: Every connection goes to Read only and waiting requests are held. Continue?
warehouses.resumePrompt: The queue restarts. Held requests stay held. Continue?
warehouses.held: Held by the emergency stop: {count}. They do not go out by themselves.
warehouses.releasePrompt: Held requests are evaluated against each connection's current mode: Read only refuses them, Canary asks for a fresh confirmation. Raise the connections' modes first. Release them?

stores.title: Stores
stores.intro: The group's Shopify stores. Each belongs to one company.
stores.addHelp: Create an app in the Shopify Dev Dashboard, install it on the store and enter its client ID and secret. The secret is stored encrypted and never shown again.
stores.name: Name
stores.codeHint: 2–5 letters/digits, permanent (used in warehouse order ids).
stores.backfillHelp: Imports orders created in the last N days. Read-only towards Shopify.
stores.codGatewaysHint: One per line, exactly as Shopify shows them.
stores.skuPrefixHint: Stripped before matching to master products.
stores.replaceCredentialsHelp: After a new secret in the Dev Dashboard. The connection is re-tested.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.store_exists: A store with this domain or code already exists.
errors.shop_not_permitted: Shopify refused: the store is not in the app's organisation.
errors.throttled: Shopify throttled the requests — try later.
errors.domain_mismatch: These credentials belong to another shop.
errors.app_uninstalled: The app was uninstalled from the store.
errors.invalid_credential: The selected credential is not a Shopify app.
errors.no_callback_url: The CRM's public URL is unknown (RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL/APP_URL).

stores.jobQueued: Queued in the background — the result appears here within a minute.
stores.jobAlready: Already waiting in the queue — the result appears here within a minute.

products.title: Products & stock
products.intro: One master product = one physical item. Store variants and warehouse codes point to it.
products.unmatchedEmpty: Every store variant is linked to a master product.
products.createHint: Creates master product {sku} and links the variant
products.masterEmpty: No master products yet. Create them from the unmatched variants.
products.name: Name

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.product_not_found: No master product with this SKU.
errors.product_exists: A master product with this SKU exists — link it instead.

products.waitWarehouses: Master products will be created from the warehouse catalogues (FHB, euShipments) once they are connected. Until then store variants stay unmatched — that is expected and nothing is sent.
